What Is Worth Reporting
fields.description: Everything else about detection is fixed in code. These two decide how much money a change has to be worth before anyone hears about it.
Anomalies costing less than this per day are not recorded, however large the percentage.
fields.label: Minimum Daily Cost Impact (USD)

fields.description: Series averaging less than this per day are ignored entirely.
fields.label: Minimum Series Cost (USD/day)
DigitalOcean Rates
fields.description: DigitalOcean publishes no price API for block storage or snapshots, so these are the rates we are charged.
